title: FTX-22b Trace leftovers: Rust-native images, adaptive threshold, JPEG/WebP
description: What FTX-22 left. (1) overlay.png, labels/pN.png and round0_audit.png drawn in Rust (needed for the browser page; the skill draws them today with vectorize.py from ftx's byte-identical draft/report, pixel-identical). OpenCV 5's putText is no longer Hershey strokes: it rasterizes built-in TrueType fonts with a modified stb_truetype (variable weights, drawing_text.cpp), so pixel parity needs that engine and its fonts, or a documented deviation (own font, the same layout); plus LINE_AA lines and circles, drawMarker, INTER_CUBIC resize (check the arm64 HAL), GEOS MaximumInscribedCircle for polylabel, textwrap. (2) --threshold adaptive (GaussianBlur fixed point; KleidiCV/carotene may override it on arm64): refused today, the 22nd oracle case. (3) JPEG/WebP input matching libjpeg-turbo/libwebp (refused with a repair today).
close_reason: Done: Rust-native review images (other agent), adaptive threshold (other agent), JPEG (deea196/fd8af18: libjpeg-turbo port, oracle raster_jpeg 218 + trace_jpeg 7) and WebP (7a7765a: libwebp port, oracle raster_webp 168 + trace_webp 6). The long tail moved to FTX-22c.

comments.author: jemanuel
comments.text: Review follow-up (295cb98): the trace's buffer is now GEOS's through noding and polygon building (buffer_graph.rs; oracle trace/buffer_topology 61 cases). Two leftovers belong here: (1) GEOS's reduced-precision retry (BufferOp::bufferReducedPrecision -> SnapRoundingNoder + ScaledNoder at 12 significant digits, working precision model in the offset generator) — without it the buffer refuses where GEOS's full-precision attempt throws (offsets of the dozens of touching parts a 1-px leader leaves with --open 0/1; 8 of 69 stress traces), and the skill falls back to vectorize.py; (2) round and limited-mitre joins differ from macOS libm atan2/sin/cos in the last bits (det:: keeps every target equal; matching libm bit for bit would need its algorithms).

comments.author: jemanuel
comments.text: Review leftovers (2026-10-13 night): (1) the audit's label scale is exp(median(log s)) as the reference computes it; det::ln/exp differ from macOS libm's log/exp in the last bit on ~30%/10% of inputs, so labels.scale_mm_per_unit can be 1 ulp off (rarely visible after the 2-decimal fitted_mm rounding); matching needs correctly-rounded log/exp that agree with Apple's libm. (2) ftx-pattern draft refuses a bool style value where Python treats True as 1 (style {"head_ease": true}). (3) The skill now routes measure/alter/annotate/scale-fit to ftx only on explicit opt-in (39a9b79d): ftx's JSON is key-sorted with indent 2, its printouts and exit codes differ, it takes neither --opt=value nor argparse abbreviations, and ftx alter never overwrites --out; trace/audit/validate stay default (trace byte-identical incl. stdout; audit JSON equal as data).

title: FTX-12b Cloth self-contact and contact speed-ups
description: Self-contact (sleeve against bodice, overlapping fronts, cuff folds; plan §11.4; the reference runs Blender self-collision at 2 mm, spec 04): cloth-cloth point-triangle and edge-edge pairs with the body-contact barrier, ACCD and lagged friction, excluding pairs that share a vertex. These pairs change the Hessian pattern: re-run the symbolic analysis when the pair set grows, or reserve a dilated pattern. Speed-ups: cache candidates per solve (re-query only when motion exceeds the pad) and a precomputed CSR scatter instead of re-sorting triplets. Accept: two overlapping strips and a folded cuff settle without crossing (exact audit after every step) and keep their offset; contact digest equal native/wasm; the release contact KATs at most half their current 13.6 s.

title: FTX-25 Further frankensim lifts (survey 2026-10-13)
description:
Remaining frankensim lifts found by the 2026-10-13 survey (frankensim 7b70bc9e; lift files with provenance, never depend on the workspace). Done already: sparse LDLT, jacobi_eigh, det (+ tan), exact orient2d/3d, the libm/powi lint (tests/no_platform_libm.rs), the stills renderer (ftx_drape::render, ftx render).

1. fs-topo/src/intersect.rs tri_tri_intersect (exact, coplanar and shared-feature cases decided) for the start/end intersection audit, replacing ftx-drape contact.rs segment_meets_triangle (which hands coplanar segments to the distance check). Low marginal value until self-contact audits need it (FTX-12b).
2. fs-ad dual.rs + gradcheck.rs (+ the Real trait) as an independent derivative oracle for KAT 1 (ftx's Jet is checked only against finite differences).
3. fs-rand philox.rs + Stream/StreamKey (not the CBC generator: pointer-width dependent) into ftx-core: seeds for RANSAC and bootstrap sigma (FTX-19), extra two-start perturbations (FTX-14).
4. fs-sparse precond.rs ilu0 + pcg (inexact Newton when the contact pattern changes; FTX-12b; benchmark before any claim).
5. fs-detaudit (staged trace, first divergent stage between native and wasm) for KAT 9 debugging; swap FNV for SHA-256.
6. fs-propcheck + metamorphic.rs (shrinking, replay, relations) for the gauntlet (FTX-24): validation/alteration invariants.
7. fs-rep-mesh halfedge/repair/winding + fs-topo manifold_certificate: refuse non-manifold or inward-wound bodies; fast winding test.
8. fit_tape: Marquardt scaling lambda*diag(J^T J) and logistic reparameterisation instead of clamping (fs-material visco.rs:856-905); fs-ascent wolfe/lbfgs/stop for FTX-21's larger fits.
Not in frankensim (write fresh): 2D polygon offset/union, constrained Delaunay (keep spade), image decoding beyond stored PNG, homography/RANSAC/ArUco, bundle adjustment.

comments.author: jemanuel
comments.text: Item 4 done differently (1054b26): fs-sparse pcg lifted as sparse/precond.rs and preconditioned by the last positive-definite LDLT factor instead of ILU(0) (a stale exact factor beats an incomplete one here): DrapeOptions::pcg_iters 20, trousers 164 -> 83 CPU s. Then bit-identical LDLT kernels (54959da) and a translation-free projection + partial-sum backward solve (ae3b823): trousers 36 s, bolero 6.7 s.

Plan: COMPREHENSIVE_PLAN_FOR_THE_DESIGN_OF_FRANKENTEXTILES.md §11.2, §11.5. Accept: known-answer tests 1, 4, 5, 6.
close_reason: Landed in ftx-drape: point-triangle/edge-edge distances (all regions) with exact derivatives via second-order forward AD (ad.rs Jet/Dual), IPC log barrier on the thickness-offset gap with the edge-edge mollifier, Gauss-Newton barrier Hessian (exact gradient), additive CCD step cap (s = 0.1), lagged smoothed Coulomb friction with lag rounds, start audit (gap, exact orient3d edge-through-triangle tests lifted from frankensim fs-ivl, winding-number inside test). Deviations: a BTreeMap uniform grid instead of a BVH (documented in CONTRACT). KAT 1 (calculus vs AD, differences, and the solver path to 1e-8), KAT 4 (2piuT = 2.531 N: 0.9 W* -0.012 mm, 1.1 W* -2.96 mm), KAT 5 (tan a = u/2 +0.11 mm, 2u -42 mm), KAT 6 (-10/-20 mm ease within dhat + 0.15 mm, hoop strain within 0.003; +30 mm clearance to 0.014 mm), KAT 9 contact digest c51df2cd... equal native debug/release and wasm32-wasip1. title: FTX-22c Trace parity long tail
description: What FTX-22b left; each refusal falls back to vectorize.py in the skill, the browser shows the refusal. (1) GEOS's reduced-precision buffer retry (BufferOp::bufferReducedPrecision: SnapRoundingNoder + ScaledNoder at 12 significant digits): 8 of 69 stress traces with --open 0/1 refuse. (2) libm last bits: round and limited-mitre joins (det:: vs macOS sin/cos/atan2) and the audit label scale exp(median(log s)) 1 ulp off. (3) ftx-pattern draft refuses a bool style value; Python uses True as 1 in arithmetic but prints it as True. (4) JPEG: CMYK/YCCK (Pillow converts with its cmyk2rgb) and progressive files libjpeg block-smooths (jdcoefct.c decompress_smooth_data); arithmetic and lossless coding. (5) WebP: the first frame of animated files (anim_decode.c keyframe on a transparent canvas), and still files with stray ANIM/ANMF chunks. (6) Photo measurement takes oriented PNG only (FTX-19's choice); JPEG phones would need cv2.imread semantics (EXIF orientation, Y-only gray).

comments.author: jemanuel
comments.text: 829cc82: the reviewers' accept/refuse findings are fixed and kept as oracle cases. WebP: WebPGetFeatures gates the file (RIFF 8-11 panic, VP8X over 10 bytes), the 8-bit alpha path's end-of-stream rule. JPEG: Pillow's 64 KiB feed after a single scan, tables-only datastreams, header-walk refusals (short JFIF/Adobe, ICC without count, cut Photoshop 8BIM). Still open here, added to the list: (7) Pillow's Python refusals not ported: an EXIF XResolution of length 1 with ResolutionUnit (IndexError in _read_dpi_from_exif) and an MPF entry under 16 bytes (_getmp struct.error). (8) Platform: Pillow's Neon VP8 transforms and Neon JPEG IDCT wrap out-of-range coefficients; ftx follows the C code, so damaged files can differ on arm64 (documented in the module docs).

title: FTX-26 Source-bearing textile platform and end-to-end material substitution
description: Plan section 25: extend the garment engine into a source-bearing textile design, simulation, alteration, optimization and machine-aware manufacturing platform. One frozen material authority must reach every relevant consumer, not a disconnected catalog. Fiber, yarn, woven/knit/nonwoven sheet, hide, laminate and fill are distinct levels. Track delivery in ftx-tm1 through ftx-tm8; prioritize characterized material data, heterogeneous garment assembly and the fixed-pattern linen/leather/performance-knit acceptance. Existing schemas, catalog import, drape resolver, workbench and Shopify refresh are foundations, not a completed empirical library, thermal comfort model or robotic sewing system.

title: FTX-26a Sourced material schema, effective mechanics and dry thermal foundation
description: Implemented in 0d2f5e8: ftx-pattern::materials owns source-bearing optional quantities, explicit units/evidence/conditions/bounds, composition validation, nine-input orthotropic sheet mechanics and dry series thermal stacks. Refuse missing properties, unapproved estimates, unstable constitutive inputs and fiber/yarn/fill passed as shells. Synthetic known-answer tests are software/physics checks, not measurements of named commercial textiles. Subsequent shared catalog/import/drape/workbench consumers build on these types.
close_reason: Foundation committed directly to main in 0d2f5e8. All nine materials unit tests passed after recovering the pinned offline Rust compiler. Does not close empirical material characterization, nonlinear construction, heterogeneous assembly, real fit or thermal-comfort claims.

title: FTX-26b Characterize construction-specific linen, leather, knit and fill records
description: Highest-value data gap (plan 25.2-25.3): acquire openly usable primary datasets and reproducible specimen measurements for common fibers/yarns, wovens/knits/nonwovens, treated cowhide, technical performance blends and fill. Preserve exact product/lot/construction/finish, units, test direction, method, conditioning, validity range and uncertainty; missing data stays missing. Acceptance: empirically justified solver-ready linen, leather and performance-knit records with directional membrane/shear/bending/contact characterization and independently checked stretch/cantilever/drape behavior, plus separately qualified thermal observations. Yarn count, blend fraction, marketing stretch and fiber bulk modulus must not become a fabric law. Existing family and supplier seed records are partial, not completed characterization.

title: FTX-26c Heterogeneous garment materials, layers and pairwise contact
description: Plan 25.3: replace global-only material assignment with per-piece/per-layer identities and per-element mass, constitutive and bending parameters. Preserve grain/mirror transforms, seams/gathers, remeshing and material hashes through motion continuation. Define bending across unlike adjacent elements and interface-pair friction; two sheets use the sum of half-thicknesses, not one global thickness/friction. Distinguish lining, load-bearing shell, adhesive laminate and loose fill. Acceptance: leather-shell jacket with knit cuffs and lining updates only assigned elements, conserves mass, uses correct skin and unlike-cloth contact, and reproduces homogeneous legacy results. Unsupported assignments must refuse until implemented, not silently inherit global defaults.

title: FTX-26d Construction-dependent nonlinear textile constitutive response
description: Plan 25.3: a generic constitutive interface for calibrated woven/knit nonlinear directional curves, tension/compression asymmetry, shear locking, directional bending, hysteresis/recovery, creep, damage and conditioning effects. Yarn/loop architecture may inform a validated homogenization model but never a guessed mixing rule. Acceptance: independent derivatives, objectivity and energy checks; published validity ranges; measured cyclic stretch/shear/bending comparisons; no silent extrapolation beyond characterized strains. Preserve the current simple effective law as an explicitly scoped model. Solver assembly must not branch on brand or fiber name.

title: FTX-26e Couple layer transport, compressed loft and draped air gaps
description: Plan 25.4: extend the dry one-dimensional ThermalStack comparison to layer-specific thickness/compression, draped air gaps, wind-dependent boundary films, moisture/evaporation, thermal bridges and transient storage with explicit wearer/environment boundary conditions. Validate dry series layers first, then coupled transport against independently measured cases. Report heat-flow fields and uncertainty separately from comfort or outdoor temperature ratings. Missing thermal data must not invalidate an otherwise supported mechanical-only consumer. Down fill power, marketing warmth, fiber identity and fabric areal mass do not imply absolute thermal resistance or safety in cold weather.

title: FTX-26f Qualify live supplier coverage and comparable purchasing history
description: Plan 25.4: expand the existing material_cost and ftx-materials price consumer, not a second price schema. Shopify refresh adapter b82536e emits exact-variant, currency-checked immutable ftx-textile-quotes/1 snapshots with source hashes and reviewed sale-unit drift checks; 15 offline tests passed, but live supplier qualification remains open. Add actual reviewed primary-supplier manifests, JSON-LD/CSV adapters, explicit intraday history semantics and configured refresh policies. Preserve old observations on failure, source rights, stock, minimum/increment, width, quality/region/terms and currency. Separate offer-sample percentiles, supplier-balanced summaries and population estimates. Integrate nesting/BOM quantities and usable yield. Never substitute finished-garment prices, guess FX/shipping/hide area, or label fixtures as live quotes.

title: FTX-26g Material-aware cutting, sewing and machine process planning
description: Plan 25.4: connect material construction to cutting direction/nap, defects/usable width/yield, nesting/BOM, seam topology/allowance/bulk, thread/needle/stitch/feed/tension and reinforcement/pucker/seam-strength constraints. Optimize layout and assembly order against explicit quality/time/cost objectives and uncertainty. Validate with physical seam/process coupons and machine capability limits. Robot execution is a separate explicit boundary requiring calibration, sensing/workholding, collision checks and interlocks. Geometric cutter/embroidery exports are not proof of process feasibility or permission to operate hardware. Unknown coatings, finishes or ignition behavior must never authorize thermal processing.

title: FTX-26h Fixed-pattern linen/leather/performance-knit substitution gate
description: Plan 25.1/25.5 acceptance: keep jacket pattern geometry and fitted body fixed, swap characterized linen, cow leather and performance knit, and verify changed mass, directional energy, bending, thickness, interface friction, sewing/gather behavior, reproducible dynamics and source-complete report hashes without solver edits or stale cache reuse. Include heterogeneous layer assignments, thermal-stack and price-width known answers, refusal of incomplete inputs, and native/wasm determinism. Report synthetic software checks separately from empirical specimen agreement, real garment fit and performance benchmarks. A changed picture alone is not a passed gate; body thermoregulation and robot execution remain separate claims.
